quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: Which drugs can affect your ability to drive?
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive under the influence of any controlled substance. The penalties are the same as driving under the influence of alcohol. Always check how a new prescription affects your driving before you drive.

questions.question: A driver entering an interstate from an entrance ramp should:

options.text: Should yield to drivers already on the interstate.
May force their way into traffic.
Can assume that other drivers will change lanes to make room.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should yield to drivers already on the interstate.
questions.explanation: When entering an interstate from an entrance ramp, you must yield to traffic already on the highway. Merge safely when you have space.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of the following, except:

options.text: How much time passes between drinks.

questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. It does not depend on physical fitness or how well you can hold alcohol.

questions.question: At night, what is hardest to see?
questions.explanation: Pedestrians are harder to see at night than road signs or other objects.

questions.question: When you see a school bus with flashing red lights, you should:

options.text: Sound their horn and pass slowly.
Stop, make sure it is safe to pass the bus, then proceed.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
Stop and remain stopped until the flashing lights extinguish.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and remain stopped until the flashing lights extinguish.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus has red flashing lights and its stop arm extended. Never pass a school bus that is loading or unloading children.

questions.question: Your vehicle hits a parked car and you cannot find the owner. You must:

options.text: Have done as much as you can.
Must stay until the police arrive.
Must leave a written notice with your name, address, and details of the accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must leave a written notice with your name, address, and details of the accident.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked car, try to find the owner. If you cannot, leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a bicycle crossing or path ahead. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride beside traffic.

questions.question: Which statement about passing is true?

options.text: Signal at least 100 feet before changing lanes to pass and make sure there is no oncoming traffic.
Use your mirrors and look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot when passing to the left.
When passing, wait until you can see both headlights of the passed car in your rearview mirror before returning to your lane.

questions.explanation: When passing, signal at least 100 feet before you change lanes. Always check your mirrors and look over your shoulder for blind spots. Wait until you see both headlights of the other car in your rearview mirror before returning to your lane.

questions.question: You must show proof of insurance to the DMV within 15 days of a crash:

options.text: If the crash results in personal injury, death, or property damage of at least $501.
Only if there is death or personal injury

questions.correctAnswerText: If the crash results in personal injury, death, or property damage of at least $501.
questions.explanation: If you are in a crash with injury, death, or property damage of $501 or more, you must provide proof of insurance to the DMV within 15 days. All drivers involved must provide proof, regardless of who was at fault.

questions.question: When passing on a two-lane road with opposite traffic, you should:

options.text: Return to the driving lane when there's enough room between you and the vehicle you passed.
Remain in the left lane if you intend to turn left.
Return to the right side of the roadway immediately.

questions.correctAnswerText: Return to the driving lane when there's enough room between you and the vehicle you passed.
questions.explanation: After passing on a two-lane road, return to the right side when you have enough space between you and the car you passed.

questions.question: When a bus signals to get back on the main road after stopping, what must you do?

options.text: Honk your horn to let them know you are there.

questions.explanation: You must yield to any bus that is signaling to enter the main road after picking up or dropping off passengers. Slow down, change lanes, or stop to let the bus safely enter traffic.

questions.question: What must you do when you see a red traffic light?
questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop before entering the intersection. You must also stop at the stop line and before entering any crosswalk.

questions.question: When driving in fog, which lights should you use?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. Also use fog lights if your vehicle has them. High beams shine upward and bounce off fog, making it harder to see.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or crying, what should they do?

options.text: They will drive normally even with these emotions.
They can drive faster because they are more alert.
They should calm down and focus before starting the car.
They should call a friend to talk while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: They should calm down and focus before starting the car.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions can distract you from driving. Worry, anger, sadness, or excitement can take your mind off the road. Take time to calm down and focus before you start driving.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you may use that lane.

questions.question: How can you avoid a truck or bus driver's blind spot?

options.text: Do not drive beside them and do not tailgate them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive beside them and do not tailgate them.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles like trucks and buses have large blind spots on the sides and rear. Avoid driving next to them and do not follow too closely behind them.

questions.question: When must drivers yield to pedestrians?

options.text: Even if the pedestrian is crossing carelessly.
Only when the pedestrian is in a crosswalk.
Only if the pedestrian is on the same side of the road.
Only if the pedestrian signals for the driver to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even if the pedestrian is crossing carelessly.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in the street, even if they are crossing against the light or crossing unsafely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped warning sign with a yellow background tells you that the divided highway is ending. Be prepared for traffic coming in both directions.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign tell you?

options.text: A no passing zone is starting.

questions.explanation: Orange signs with black markings indicate construction, maintenance, or emergency work ahead.

questions.question: What does drinking coffee do after drinking alcohol?

options.text: It lowers your blood alcohol level.
It does not change your blood alcohol level.
It raises your blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: It does not change your blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee will not lower your blood alcohol level. While it may help you stay awake, it cannot make you sober or reduce the alcohol in your system.
